ideas.pitch: An AI-powered coordination platform tailored for Princeton-area community volunteers and senior centers to group nearby seniors into shared social outings with student drivers.
ideas.title: Princeton Local Transit & Senior Outings Coordinator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets clear measurable social impact and replicates the winning formula of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting tool utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict campus facility maintenance failures or local safety incidents based on historical logs.
ideas.title: AI Campus Incident & Safety Forecasting Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous data science and predictive modeling, mirroring the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winning strategy.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition assistant customized specifically for Princeton University dining hall menus, delivering personalized meal recommendations and dietary tracking.
ideas.title: Princeton Dining Hall AI Nutrition & Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and students feel themselves every day on campus, directly following the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon winning approach.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace enabling students to buy and sell micro-tasks using secure escrow payments on Base.
ideas.title: Autonomous AI Agent Marketplace for Student Services
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements modern web3 agentic patterns that secured 1st place at the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered trust and patient acquisition platform tailored for local dental and medical practices in the Princeton area to streamline onboarding.
ideas.title: AI Patient Acquisition Engine for Local Princeton Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate local economic value to small businesses, echoing the Elevate X Prize Hackathon winning methodology.
